opportunities.name: Held-sphere attack clock
opportunities.objective: Test attack weaving while preserving a six-second sphere for E/R.
opportunities.mechanic: Q spheres remain six seconds and W can hold an object for five. Lich Bane and Nashor test real attacks during that preparation instead of treating spheres as pets. E turns a positioned sphere into a stun and R counts three to seven actual spheres; AP supports both spells and attacks, with Seraph providing finite earned resources.
opportunities.requiredState: Sphere ages and held-object time are recorded; attack animation does not delay E beyond sphere expiry.
opportunities.failure: The attack loses a sphere, a stun or a high-count R and lowers burst.
opportunities.test: Compare spell-only versus one attack before sphere-E, preserving the same sphere count/ages.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Sphere manipulation does not repeatedly consume Spellblade without real attacks.

opportunities.name: Upgraded throw threshold
opportunities.objective: Investigate W upgraded true damage as a low-health finisher before R execution.
opportunities.mechanic: Retained W ThrowDamage is base plus 0.65 AP; PassiveBonusDamage multiplies that result by 0.12 plus 0.0002 AP, matching the tooltip percentage rather than flat true damage. Shadowflame explicitly enhances low-health magic and true damage. AP amplification at 120 Splinters is finite; R execution requires its own earned upgrade.
opportunities.requiredState: Earn the relevant W/R upgrades, record Splinters and target health before each hit.
opportunities.failure: An unupgraded W or shield keeps the target outside the desired finishing state.
opportunities.test: Log W magic and true packets above/below 40% health, then R at fixed sphere counts.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration affects W magic damage, not its true-damage bonus.

ruledOut.idea: Seven spheres assumed on every R
ruledOut.reason: R adds only nearby existing spheres to the three orbiting ones, capped at seven; preparation must be recorded.

unknowns: Q/W tooltips contain localization tokens, but retained calculations supply their base/AP damage. Upgrade thresholds are cross-referenced and need source/live verification.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: The attack loses a sphere, a stun or a high-count R and lowers burst.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Sphere manipulation does not repeatedly consume Spellblade without real attacks.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Lich Bane, Nashor's Tooth, Seraph's Embrace, Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.
